_avail.description: Scalable Wireless Receiver for Axient Digital and ULX-D Systems
_avail.note: 1.4 A max AC input per user guide; W not published. Also PoE class 1 for network/ShowLink. Datasheet URL = PDF of official user guide (no separate spec sheet linked). Price list net weight 4.854 kg differs from datasheet weight (datasheet value used).
